text: The Parks and Environment Committee currently has a vacancy. Council was previously advised that this vacancy would be addressed once the Councillor for Ward 33 was in place. Council has appointed Councillor Jonathan Tsao to the office of Councillor for Ward 33, Don Valley East. As Councillor Tsao does not currently have a Standing Committee appointment, this Motion recommends that Councillor Tsao be appointed to the Parks and Environment Committee for the balance of the term.

City Council on May 22, 23 and 24, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint Councillor Jonathan Tsao to the Parks and Environment Committee for a term of office until November 30, 2018 and until a successor is appointed.
